name: application-copy-field
title: Copy-to-Clipboard Field
description: Read-only value fields with a trailing copy button and copied confirmation state for sharing API keys, invite links, and IDs.
useWhen: Read-only value fields with a trailing copy button and copied confirmation state for sharing API keys, invite links, and IDs.
avoidWhen: Avoid copy-to-clipboard field when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Copy-to-Clipboard Field uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
